route.name: The Coal Veins, Caverns & Blue Ridge Secrets Loop
route.direction: Connecticut art and folk-faith opening into Pennsylvania's industrial spine, south through Harpers Ferry and Shenandoah; Frederick, Moravian Bethlehem and western Connecticut return
route.summary: A warmer Appalachian loop that opens with a Gothic art castle and a handmade biblical hill, descends into an anthracite mine and caverns, then climbs through Harpers Ferry and Skyline Drive to a truth-centered Charlottesville art, history and live-music day. The return uses Orthodox Sunday, Civil War medicine, a Moravian farm, respectful institutional reuse and a stained-glass globe.

hard_closures_or_conflicts: Central Market and Troll Market are deliberately placed on Tuesday; moving Lancaster to Wednesday breaks both.
Jefferson School closes at 13:00 Saturday, so the Monticello product must finish on time.
The Icon Museum in Clinton is closed Wednesday and was rejected from the return day.
Burnside buildings are not promised on the Monday holiday; only dawn-dusk grounds are core.
No OSRM baseline contains live traffic; days 9 and 10 must use live ETAs and cannot absorb central-Bethlehem or outlet detours.
